paragraphs: Zeira bar Chama, Resh Lakish’s host. A scribal error: Yoma 78a has Zeira bar Chama, host to Ammi, Assi, Yehoshua ben Levi and all Caesarea’s rabbis. He told Rav Yosef son of Yehoshua ben Levi,“Son of Torah, come, I shall tell you an excellent deed your father did.” Rabbi Zeira bar Chama; Rabbi Yose bar Chanina in Yehoshua ben Levi’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Yoma, beginning of Yom HaKippurim; Taanit 1:6 has a different reading. His burial and Rabbi Meir’s—who was academy head there, Benjamin’s travels—is in Mila (G. A. Y.); Rabbi Mari, in Benjamin’s travels.
